description: Freelance software developer and web engineer, specialized in front-end web development and passionate about software engineering in general.
AboutMeText1: I am a full-stack web engineer and software developer, with a Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
AboutMeText2: Computer science became a passion of mine since the late 90s when I had my first PC. Since then I’ve spent the majority of my life in front of a computer screen, gaming during the early years, or later blogging, learning and working with web design and development.
AboutMeText3: Nowadays I am primarily involved in the various areas of full-stack web development, specialized in Javascript and the front-end world, constantly exploring latest trends and technologies.
AboutMeText4: Other areas of my interest include progressive web apps, web accessibility, SEO, A.I., machine learning, text mining, global politics, psychology and astronomy. Outside of work life I enjoy fitness training, swimming and playing tennis.
